headlines.title: US Yields Fall From 2002 High as Oil Dips, Bessent Vows On Debt
headlines.summary: Yields at 2002 highs is the kind of tape that keeps every portfolio manager up at night — when the long bond moves like this, nothing is safe, from REITs to growth stocks to credit spreads. The pullback off those highs, aided by oil sliding below $100 and Bessent talking down the debt load, gives the equity bid some breathing room, but this is the dominant macro story driving everything else right now. Watch the 10-year like a hawk — it's running the show.

headlines.title: Oil Inventories in Western Nations Exhausted, Vitol CEO Warns of Tight Market
headlines.summary: When the boss of the world's biggest independent oil trader says the cupboard is bare, you listen — this isn't some analyst with a model, this is the guy who actually moves the barrels. Tight inventories heading into winter, with Mideast flows still at only 80% of pre-war levels per Shell's CEO, means energy stocks, airlines, truckers, and consumer discretionary all feel the squeeze. The G7's 100-million-barrel release is a band-aid on a bullet wound.

headlines.title: DeepSeek to Raise Over $12 Billion in Tencent-Backed Funding
headlines.summary: Twelve billion dollars flowing into DeepSeek ahead of a 2027 Hong Kong IPO is a shot across the bow of every U.S. AI name — this validates the Chinese AI competitive threat and puts pressure on the Nvidia-to-hyperscaler trade to justify its valuations. Tencent's backing means Beijing is serious, and a $50 billion Moonshot AI valuation in the same news cycle tells you the AI arms race just got a second front. Semis, cloud, and the whole AI infrastructure complex need to reprice this risk.
